notes.title: Update of the game
notes.notes:
Dear players,

The weekly update of the game will be proceed the 04/06

Start of the update: 9:30 AM
End of the update: 11:30 AM

During the update, servers will be unavailable.

New function unlocked
1.	Pet Aptitude
2.	Primeval Island

System Optimization
Holy Blessing will be available at 9:00 now.

Resources
1.	Added event pictures.
2.	Added new resources: Bow Tie, Father’s Day Gift and Fatherly Love Title Card

Events
1.	Now you may get Bastet • Naivety Shards in Primeval Island.


Bug Fixes
1.	Fixed the bug that made Flag Fiend's Ring Equipment in Dream Star, Treasure Chest and Lucky Tree have no random stats.
2.	Fixed the Points for some Mounts in Cube.

V2.3 Contents:
Added new features:
1.	Pet Aptitude
2.	Primeval Island

Optimizations:
1.	Infinite War Improvements:
a) The camera no longer follows you in real time when you move in the Infinite War.
b) Improved mini map.
c) Improved chat button and display.
2.	Farm Improvement: Unlocked the last 3 Lots in the Farm.
3.	Added new goals.
a) Added more stages for goals.
b) More goals are added.
c) Maximized Goals Level to 30.
d) Added rewards for Goals reaching Lv. 26 to Lv. 30.
4.	Growth Contest Improvement: Purchases will receive Points in the Growth Contest.
5.	Skill Talent Improvement: Added extra Talent Pages.
6.	Battlefield Rewards Improvement: Event Rewards are based on Battlefield Level.
7.	Crystal Shop Improvement: Buying chances will be reset after the event.
8.	Element Catacomb Improvement: Extra rewards are based on the clearance time.
9.	Event Features Improvement: Spend items to feed Pets to get Event Points.

notes.title: Update of the game
notes.notes:
Dear players,

The weekly update of the game will be proceed the 16/04

Start of the update: 9:30 AM
End of the update: 11:30 AM

Content of the update:

1. Dragon Mirage Realm
Unlocks at: Lv. 28
Feature:
1. Players who have joined Clans can enter during 20:30 to 21:00.
2. There are 10 floors. Players will be ranked based on the clearance time. Top 5 players in the ranking will receive rewards, including all members of the same Clan.
3. Random events: Teleporting, Quiz, Guard (Keys are dropped from monsters), Chest.
4. There are 4 teleport doors: One of them will make you advance 1 floor, two of them will teleport you to the previous floor and the one left will teleport you to the same floor.
Rewards: Clan Boss Feeding Material

2. Mount Race
Unlocks at: Lv. 69
Number of players: Timely Event
Details:
1. Players will be matched to fight with each other. The Multi-Arena that starts from Friday to Sunday is replaced by Mount Race.
2. Players need to follow the route.
3. Players will receive items. Item effect: Speedup yourself, slow down opponent, petrify opponent and immune to a debuff once.
4. Activate and use Equitation Skills to win. Click the specified button to use Equitation Skills: ↑, ↓, ← and →
5. Mounts’ Mood affect items’ effect. (Speedup and slow down)

3. Now Cross-server Boss won’t receive less DMG when its HP is low.

4. Fixed the bug that makes Bag Sort button in Treasure Hunting invalid.

5. Fixed the display bug in Love War and Everlasting Battle.

6. Now players can use Dragon Covenant when digging in the Free Highland.

7. Fixed the bug that shows not enough space in your bag when you use Blessed Augment or dissolve Blessed Augment for 100 times and then use unidentified Blessed Augment.

8. Optimized Treasure Draw:
a) Now players can skip the animation.
b) Added “Quick Treasure Hunt”.

9. Optimized Farm:
a) Added “Quick Grow”. Now players can spend ambers to grow crops at once.
b) Added “Harvest All”, “Quick Weed”, “Quick Fumigate”, “One-click Steal Crops” and “One-click Revive”.

10. Optimized Equipment Enhancement: Lower level Equipment will be enhanced first when using Auto Enhance function.

11. Now Vice Leader can kick players out.

Dear players,

The weekly update of the game will be proceed the 19/03

Start of the update: 8:30 AM
End of the update: 10:30 AM

During the update, servers will be unavailable.

Content: Infinite War

Requirement: Lv. 50
Feature:
1. You don’t need to sign up for it. Enter to match opponents when it starts. Each room contains 100 players.
2. It is a strategic feature . The Base summons Minions to attack enemy Outposts and Base. Players need to attack Minions and Outposts. Bosses will be refreshed automatically. The Base will send elite monsters after you defeat bosses.
3. Spend Points to improve Outposts and Base Durability. Defeat enemies or enemy Outposts to receive Points. Spend Points to upgrade Tech in the Base. Upgrade ATK, DEF and HP to increase Minions’ ATK, Outposts’ Durability and Minions’ max HP.
4. Break the enemy’s Base to win.
Rewards: King Crests and Limited Mounts

notes.title: Update of the game
notes.notes:
Dear players,

The weekly update of the game will be proceed the 22/01.

Start of the update: 9:30 AM
End of the update: 11:30 AM

During the update, servers will be unavailable.

Content:

1. Class Evolving System
- Classes
Requirement: Ultimate Lv.3
Feature:
1. Players can switch between 3 Classes. Different class has different stats. Classes suppress each other.
2. Players can defeat Wild Monsters and join dungeons to receive Class EXP to upgrade their Classes.
3. Players need to escalate Class Level to receive Class EXP when Class reaches the highest level. Reach the highest level and equip your current stage's Equipment when Class EXP is full to escalate class. Class Level will be Lv.1 after escalating.
Required items: Class EXP, Class Equipment
2. Class Evolving System
- Class Equipment
Requirement: Ultimate Lv.3
Feature: Players can equip the same stage equipment or lower stage equipment. Players can get higher stage Class Equipment from the Pandemonium, Events and by engulfing other Class Equipment.
Required items: Class Equipment
3. Pandemonium
Requirement: Ultimate Lv.5
Number of players: Solo Dungeon
Details: Players can challenge boss for 3 times everyday to receive Class EXP and Class Equipment. Defeat the boss to receive extra rewards based on rankings.
Output: Class EXP, Class Equipment

notes.title: Update of the game
notes.notes:
Dear players,

The weekly maintenance will be performed the 16th October.

Start of the maintenance: 10:30 am
End of the maintenance: 12:30 am

During the maintenance, servers will be unavailable.

Updated Item Preview--Clan Level 
In Dragon Awaken, players will never adventure alone, and they can always find some other players with same goal to fight together! Clan is a place for those players. In the Clan, quests are used to accumulate clan fund and the leader can spend the fund to upgrade his clan, such as creating some buildings and learning other technologies. Clan will lose certain amount of fund daily, and insufficient funds will degrade or dismiss the clan. What's more, there is Clan Boss in Clan system, which you could use the food to upgrade it to receive the rewards!
